messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — per-tenant-log-forwarder-error · customer=BlueRidge-Capital · environment=VPC-dedicated · severity=P2 · metric=forwarder_errors > 50/min · runbook=tenant-log-forwarder-lease-rotation
priya (eng-oncall): seeing the page, assigning leo to lead the mitigation. Sam, can you confirm customer impact?
leo (sre): I’m on it. quick q — is this dropping spans/traces or only audit/log lines? any recent deploys to the blue-ridge tenant?
eva (eng-runtime): we’re seeing auth failures from the tenant forwarder to the central ingestor. sample logs:```
{"time":"2026-03-15T12:39:07Z","level":"error","msg":"PUT /ingest 403","tenant":"blue-ridge","service":"log-forwarder","err":"AccessDenied: Token expired"}
{"time":"2026-03-15T12:40:22Z","level":"warn","msg":"backlog flush failed, retrying","tenant":"blue-ridge","service":"log-forwarder","code":403}
```
ops-bot: metric alert — tenant_log_forwarder_latency spike; label tenant=blue-ridge; trace-forwarding_drop_rate=0.18
sam (customer-success): BlueRidge reported they can’t see request-level logs in Console since ~12:38 UTC. customer is asking for ETA and whether we can export raw logs.
leo (sre): thanks. EVA, do we have a suspected root cause?
eva (eng-runtime): leaning on IAM token/lease rotation failure. lease-manager rotated creds but didn’t update the forwarder role binding due to a race in the rotation handler. quick mitigation attempt: restart forwarder pods in tenant namespace to pickup new creds. command I’m going to try:```
# restart forwarder to force token refresh
kubectl -n tenants-blue-ridge rollout restart deployment/log-forwarder
kubectl -n tenants-blue-ridge get pods -l app=log-forwarder -w
```
priya (eng-oncall): do the restart and report logs. I’ll prepare customer comms. handing to leo for execution.
leo (sre): starting restart now. will tail logs and post updates.
leo (sre): restart in progress — pods terminating -> creating. tailing logs:```
2026-03-15T12:41:10Z info forwarder starting
2026-03-15T12:41:12Z info auth: fetching creds
2026-03-15T12:41:13Z error auth: assume-role failed status=403
```
eva (eng-runtime): ok I’m performing role rebind as an extra step — running the IAM binding fix:```
# rebind role to tenant forwarder principal
aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name blue-ridge-forwarder-role --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::redwood:policy/forwarder-ingest
# then refresh tokens
kubectl -n tenants-blue-ridge delete secret forwarder-aws-creds || true
kubectl -n tenants-blue-ridge create secret generic forwarder-aws-creds --from-literal=key=REPLACED
```
ops-bot: Event — forwarder_auth_rebind succeeded for tenant=blue-ridge (event_id=evt-3051234567-01)
leo (sre): after rebind: backlog flush progressed, ingestion resumed. current estimate: ~85% of backlog ingested. traces are being stitched but we will likely lose some spans from 12:38–12:42 UTC window.
sam (customer-success): passed to customer: they see partial replay starting in Console. they asked for a guaranteed export of the raw objects for their audit team. are we able to provide a signed S3 export?
priya (eng-oncall): yes we can. create presigned S3 export for the backlog shard (secure, 7-day expiry). sam, prepare a support case and include the export link — mark as enterprise-handshake and include legal cc.
eva (eng-runtime): additional step: we’ll trigger targeted replay for trace keys to try to rehydrate lost spans. example replay command:```
# replay specific trace keys from object storage
python tools/replay_traces.py --tenant blue-ridge --start 2026-03-15T12:38:00Z --end 2026-03-15T12:45:00Z --batch-size 500
```
leo (sre): monitoring ingestion rate. current backfill ETA: 30–60 minutes depending on S3 rate and backlog size. critical: add alert for lease-manager rotation failures to prevent repeat.
priya (eng-oncall): logging this as P2 tenant impact. I’m tagging product/legal/security for enterprise notification. creating incident channel and runbook entry now.
sam (customer-success): customer wants a formal timeline and a post-incident report. I’ll collect timestamps and the list of missing windows.
eva (eng-runtime): technical follow-ups: 1) patch lease-manager rotation handler (race) 2) add healthcheck on forwarder for token validity (soft-failure alert) 3) add metric for assume-role 403 rate per-tenant
leo (sre): next operational steps for handoff: 1) confirm full ingestion and close pager 2) deploy lease-manager patch to canary then prod 3) add alert thresholds and run the postmortem. I’ll own ingestion confirmation.
priya (eng-oncall): handing off to morning oncall @maya (eng-oncall-morning) in 15m — please watch backlog, verify replay completion, and follow up with customer comms. I’ll create the incident summary for the report. :white_check_mark:
maya (eng-oncall-morning): acknowledged — I’ll monitor and post final status updates once backfill completes.
priya (eng-oncall): thanks everyone. closing active mitigation thread; will update channel when postmortem is scheduled. :bow:
